title: The new proceedBranchFn git calls use spawnSync from node:child_process, consis…
body: The new proceedBranchFn git calls use spawnSync from node:child_process, consistent with this file's existing file-wide pattern (surgical). A separate migration to Bun.spawnSync (as begun in CAM-308 for check-all.ts) would align sidecar.ts with the Bun-first invariant; out of scope for this fix.
